rules.authorization_order: Before creating an Alpha 015 data directory, lock, plan, receipt, temporary file, or network request, recompute readiness and require a verified Experiment 0015 preregistration and activation lock that authorize development-only acquisition.
rules.scope: Construct the exact development-only file inventory from immutable prior-day universe bindings. Locked-validation dates are not planned, probed, or downloaded.
rules.size_preflight: Obtain an exact HEAD Content-Length inventory for every planned publisher archive before downloading any return bytes. Require free space of at least 1.25 times estimated payload plus a fixed 25 GiB reserve.
rules.transport: Download each archive to a same-filesystem temporary file, require its GET Content-Length to equal the sealed HEAD measurement, stream no more than the fixed compressed-size limit, fsync it, then verify the publisher CHECKSUM before archive validation and atomic sealing.
rules.integrity: The publisher CHECKSUM, exact archive filename, single expected CSV member, schema, UTC day, aggregate-trade continuity, and canonical funding response remain mandatory. A partial, corrupt, mismatched, or unplanned file is never recorded as completed.
rules.resumability: Use one non-blocking acquisition lock and replayable progress receipts bound to the exact plan. A completed batch is write-once only after all expected files pass the existing phase-bundle validation.
rules.execution_boundary: This amendment governs research data transport only. It does not alter signals, timing, universe membership, costs, model parameters, evaluation gates, validation access, or live-trading authorization.
